The composer of the famous **"Gloria in D Major" (RV 589)** is **Antonio Vivaldi**.

Vivaldi was born in **Venice, Italy** in 1678.

The most famous bridge in Venice is the **Rialto Bridge** (Italian: *Ponte di Rialto*). It is the oldest of the four bridges spanning the Grand Canal and is one of Venice's most iconic landmarks. Other well-known Venetian bridges include the Bridge of Sighs (Ponte dei Sospiri), but the Rialto Bridge is generally considered the most famous.
